summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on resolving issues with commits in the ml-api, specifically concerning data readiness for calculating sessions. A key task was correcting session migration data.

It was determined that a commit rollback was necessary to fix the issue. One participant offered to make a new commit from their branch containing the expected changes, while another suggested pushing the project entirely again if direct fixes failed.
decisions: The issue with commits in ml-api was addressed by rolling back specific commits.
action_items: A participant needs to take over fixing the session migration ticket/issue.
